purpose: Compare one compact recurrent latent-transition student with the completed slate-trained NativeDinoPrefixStudent control while keeping context support, action-query slate, teacher targets, training budget, and held-out evaluation fixed.

research_question.primary: At fixed 256-context four-query slate support and 1500 updates, can a shared causal recurrent latent-transition student match or improve the read-only NativeDinoPrefixStudent control on held-out planner-candidate ranking while reducing parameter and predictor-latency cost?
research_question.mechanism: The recurrent student predicts one next native visual/proprio latent from the current predicted latent and current packed action token, then feeds that prediction into the next transition. A single shared transition cell is reused for all five action steps, exposing the action-conditioned predictor's temporal mechanism directly instead of encoding the whole action prefix with a parallel causal transformer.
research_question.unit_of_analysis: one held-out context x one fresh action-prefix seed block; 300 candidates inside a block are nested measurements, not independent replicates
research_question.primary_comparison: recurrent treatment minus read-only slate-MSE control at step 1500, aligned by (action-prefix seed, held-out context index)
research_question.secondary_comparison: trainable parameter count and predictor-only latency of recurrent treatment versus the read-only control
research_question.architecture_contrast: This is one frozen architecture contrast, not a width, training-length, query-density, context-density, or rank-loss sweep.

entry_evidence.optimization_length: FAIL: extending the existing direct student to 1500 updates did not materially improve ranking
entry_evidence.capacity_h256: FAIL: h256 did not improve ranking over h128 at the frozen budget
entry_evidence.context_density: FAIL: adding same-episode context support did not pass the ranking-effect gate
entry_evidence.query_slate_rank: FAIL: planner-aware listwise rank treatment did not improve over identical slate-trained MSE control
entry_evidence.authorization: The next controlled axis is temporal student architecture: replace the direct prefix transformer with one shared recurrent native-latent transition cell.

scope.observation_encoder_scope: out of scope; use cached native observation latents

architecture.description: Two-layer causal action-prefix transformer followed by shared per-patch visual and proprio residual heads.
architecture.inference_rollout: parallel prefix encoding with anchor latent; no recurrent feedback

baseline.summary_use: Use its stored per-block metrics, logged-action MSE, causality, latency, convergence, and integrity fields as the paired read-only reference.
baseline.initial_state_pairing: not_applicable: the architecture contrast has different parameter shapes; use the same initialization seed and all shared data/schedule seeds, but do not claim identical parameter state.

treatment.name: recurrent_shared_latent_transition
treatment.parameterization: one shared cell and shared output heads reused for k=0..4; no per-horizon parameters

inputs.initial_visual: cached native context[visual][:,-1] with shape [B, patches, 384]
inputs.current_action: one normalized packed action token a_k with shape [B, 10]
inputs.history: only the current predicted native visual/proprio state; no teacher-forced future latent

cell.step_definition: At each k, consume only (visual_k, proprio_k, action_k), emit (visual_{k+1}, proprio_{k+1}), and feed those predictions into step k+1.
cell.patch_summary: mean over projected visual patches; this is the only spatial mixing
cell.feedback: The predicted native outputs, not detached targets, are the next-step inputs during both training and evaluation.
cell.normalization: LayerNorm on shared condition and each modality update

treatment.causality_contract: Output through horizon k may depend on actions 0..k only; changing action tokens after k while holding the prefix fixed must not change outputs through k.
treatment.loss: mean dense native-latent MSE over all 32 query rows, five predicted steps, and native visual/proprio dimensions
forbidden: teacher or source predictor module inside the student

train_context_pool.manifest: reuse the completed Dhigh 256-context manifest exactly

context_schedule.generation: CPU permutation of 0..255 every 32 updates; consume eight consecutive ordinals

teacher_targets.target: detached dense future native visual/proprio latents for the exact four-query slate rows

seeds.cpu_generator_policy: Generate all schedules, slates, held-out candidates, and timing candidates with explicit CPU generators before GPU transfer.

training.loss_reduction: mean over query rows, horizons, and native latent dimensions

ranking.candidate_bank: reuse the exact held-out candidate bank and order from QUERY_SLATE_RANK_FREEZE

logged_action_fidelity.action: each held-out context's logged action prefix

causality.procedure: For unchanged prefix lengths 1,2,3,4, change only later action tokens and compare outputs through the unchanged prefix.

latency.boundary: cached native observation latent plus normalized action prefix through the predictor
latency.reduction: 1 - median(recurrent student ms) / median(frozen teacher ms)
latency.baseline_comparison: Report recurrent ms / read-only control ms as a diagnostic; it is not the primary success gate.

parameter_tradeoff.count: count trainable parameters in each student from the instantiated state dictionary
parameter_tradeoff.gate_role: diagnostic tradeoff; parameter count alone cannot establish a scientific win

heldout_evaluation.telemetry: During GPU execution append utilization and VRAM samples every 30 seconds to the job log.

architecture_effect.comparison: recurrent treatment step1500 - read-only slate-MSE control step1500

logged_mse_noninferiority.comparison: recurrent treatment / read-only control on held-out logged-action teacher-relative MSE

decision_levels.architecture_effect: PASS iff pairing_and_integrity passes and all four architecture_effect thresholds pass.
decision_levels.full_replacement: GO iff pairing_and_integrity passes, recurrent absolute fidelity passes, logged MSE non-inferiority passes, causality passes, and predictor-only latency passes. This is independent of relative architecture effect.
decision_levels.recurrent_supported_replacement: GO iff architecture_effect PASS and full_replacement GO.
decision_levels.invalidity: If the read-only baseline, shared slate bank, held-out pairing, recurrent integrity, or causality contract is invalid, report NO-GO and do not interpret ranking deltas.
decision_levels.no_retuning: Do not change cell structure, hidden size, seeds, schedule, loss, steps, snapshots, or thresholds after observing results.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_architecture_effect_pass: Under this frozen DINO-WM PushT predictor-level contract, the specified shared recurrent native-latent transition student improves held-out candidate ranking over the read-only slate-trained direct student control at the stated paired thresholds.
claim_boundary.allowed_if_full_replacement_go: The recurrent student independently satisfies the stated predictor-level replacement gates while preserving strict action-prefix causality.
claim_boundary.parameter_latency_sentence: Report parameter and predictor-only latency differences as an engineering tradeoff; neither alone proves ranking or closed-loop benefit.
claim_boundary.baseline_boundary: The 24494756 control is a read-only historical paired reference aligned by shared data banks and held-out blocks; it is not rerun and its checkpoints are not loaded.
forbidden: encode_obs speedup or observation encoder claim
full planner or closed-loop task success
claim that fewer parameters alone caused ranking improvement
causal claims beyond this architecture contrast

execution_constraints.checkpoint_return: No checkpoint retrieval is required as the primary result artifact.
